grading-script-models/task.md
  mode: blocks
  title: acme/grading-script-models
  instruction: 5 words; starts 'Fix the bug in `app.py`.'
  blocks: toml task
  config: block (name, verifier, version)
  grading needs a model: yes (a script): [verifier] env names ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, OPENAI_API_KEY; verifier/test.sh runs RewardKit, whose judges call a model
  worst-case grading time: not bounded by the task: no [verifier] timeout is set
  warning: verifier.env.OPENAI_API_KEY resolves ${OPENAI_API_KEY} from the host; a runtime resolves it only if the operator allows that variable, and never a provider key: a seat that calls a model gets the runtime's proxy and a scoped token instead (task.md)
  warning: verifier.env.K resolves ${ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL} from the host; a runtime resolves it only if the operator allows that variable, and never a provider key: a seat that calls a model gets the runtime's proxy and a scoped token instead (task.md)
  warning: grading calls a model from a script ([verifier] env names ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, OPENAI_API_KEY; verifier/test.sh runs RewardKit, whose judges call a model), but [verifier] models is not true: set [verifier] models = true, so the runtime gives the verifier a seat token and the proxy's URL. Without it the script cannot reach a model on a task.md runtime, and its judge calls fail (task.md)
  ok
